case_title: GAIL C. SIMON VS. BARBARA BUCCIARELLI ET AL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,000.00 FILED BY SIMON, GAIL C. AS TO DEFENDANT BUCCIARELLI, BARBARA GHEDDARI, BARBARA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-28-2015 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF SIMON, GAIL C. ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF SIMON, GAIL C. AS TO DEFENDANT BUCCIARELLI, BARBARA
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED APR-16-2015, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT BUCCIARELLI, BARBARA
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF ***FEE FOR SERVICE:$0.00*** SERVED APR-23-2015, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT GHEDDARI, BARBARA
REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY TELEPHONE FILED BY DEFENDANT GHEDDARI, BARBARA
ORDER RE REQUEST TO APPEAR AT HEARING BY TELEPHONE (SMALL CLAIMS) IS GRANTED

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. "PLAINTIFF IS AN ASSIGNEE OF A PROMISSORY NOTE ON WHICH PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS BASED", PER JUDGE MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT EXCEPT DEFENDANT BARBARA GHEDDARI WHO WAS PRESENT THROUGH COURT CALL. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
